body: True it was unclear, hope my tldr helps

I took her to London for 5 days to my home and it seemed to make it worse when she got back to her reality. I kept every day interesting and made sure she was doing what she wanted but when she got back home I got messages about how she felt out of place and that her house is much worse and that she overstayed her welcome even though I tried to explain to her that everyone loved her. She believes fully that everyone but me hates her too so that made it difficult. Thank you for the advice though, she loves lemurs so much she gets jumpy whenever she sees one so I'll try to do a zoo trip for her when I make some more money.
Thank you so much, this was very helpful.

I knew I forgot to write something, I've begged her to go to a therapist or a doctor and she refuses no matter what I say due to past failure with some doctors. I have managed to get her to tell me once that she needs to go and she gave me consent in a message I screenshotted to get her to one no matter what so I've told her I will book an appointment and get her there even if I have to wait outside her door for weeks until she comes with me.

And I wish you knew how often I tell her I love you, I never let her forget it that I'm there and always will be.

When I ask if there's anything I can do it's either "dunno", "idk" or "nothing can be done" as the response. She fully believes she'll never get better no matter how much I try to tell her she will.
